description: Sideloaded MSIX updates do not check on launch because the App Installer file uses an old schema namespace, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/67271306/why-does-the-msix-not-automatically-check-for-updates-every-time-the-application.
prompt: We publish a WPF app as an MSIX to an Azure App Service, not through the Store. Users install from the `.appinstaller` link, but when I replace the bundle with 1.0.2 the installed app does not prompt on launch; clicking the web installer does see the update.
